units.rawText: In reality, I only did three things each day: take care of the animals, study certain creatures that only existed in stories, and sleep.
units.displayText: In reality, I only did three things each day: take care of the animals, study certain creatures that only existed in stories, and sleep.

units.rawText: There was nothing else to do but sleep in a zoo that nobody visited. What drove me were those animals that might not even exist. That's why I kept chasing their trail...

units.rawText: What exactly was it that was affecting me? I never received any clear instructions, and I couldn't find any answers in my neural cloud.

spans.text: What exactly was it that was affecting me? I never received any clear instructions, and I couldn't find any answers in my neural cloud.

units.rawText: Perhaps that was supposed to be part of my responsibilities... But then, why was I created?
units.displayText: Perhaps that was supposed to be part of my responsibilities... But then, why was I created?

spans.text: Perhaps that was supposed to be part of my responsibilities... But then, why was I created?

units.rawText: (Yawn) The more I think, the easier I crash. I should just stick to researching fantasy animals. See, I've collected all the files I could find about alicorns. The pile is about as tall as I am now.
